name: loot-crates
author: Takaro
description: Key-based loot crates. Admins define crates with a weighted reward table: currency, items or both, each with a rarity. Players get keys by buying them with currency ({prefix}crate buy), from a Takaro shop listing that uses the giveCrateKey shop action, or from an admin ({prefix}crate givekey). {prefix}crate open uses a key and rolls a reward; rare and better drops are announced to the server. {prefix}crates lists every crate, your keys and the odds.
summary: Key-based loot crates with weighted reward tables (currency and/or items, with rarities). Players get keys by buying them with currency, from a Takaro shop listing (giveCrateKey shop action) or from an admin, then open crates in chat. Rare drops are broadcast; odds are shown in-game.

crates.title: Crates
crates.description: The crates players can open. Use short names without spaces, players type them in chat.

name.title: Name
name.description: One word, players type it: {prefix}crate open <name>. Also used to match shop listings.

keyPrice.title: Key price
keyPrice.description: Currency per key for {prefix}crate buy. 0 = keys cannot be bought with currency (shop or admin only).

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.description: Weighted reward table. Chance of a reward = its weight / sum of all weights.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown to the player and in broadcasts.

items.title: Items
items.description: Items the player receives. Item = the game's item code or a Takaro item ID.

broadcastMinRarity.title: Broadcast from rarity
broadcastMinRarity.description: Rewards of this rarity or better are announced to the whole server.

maxKeysPerPurchase.title: Max keys per purchase
maxKeysPerPurchase.description: Most keys a player can buy with one {prefix}crate buy.

permissions.description: Allows giving crate keys to players with crate givekey.
Discount in percent on crate keys bought with currency. The count is the percentage (for example 20 = 20% off). Good for VIP roles.

crate.description: Buy, open or give crate keys.
crate.helpText: crate buy <name> [amount] | crate open <name> | crate givekey <player> <name> [amount] (admin)

crates.description: List crates, your keys and the odds.
crates.helpText: crates shows every crate and your keys. crates <name> shows the odds of one crate.

arguments.name: crate
arguments.helpText: Optional crate name to see its odds

giveCrateKey.description: Gives crate keys to the buyer. The listing name must contain the crate name (for example "Gold crate key"); start it with a number and x for packs ("5x Gold crate key"). Keys given = pack size x amount ordered.
